opening.argument: The video primarily walks viewers through a Litecoin-mining site: it explains entering a wallet address, starting mining, reviewing plans, and using referral features. The description presents the site as requiring zero investment and discloses that some links may earn commissions. The walkthrough also describes a Litecoin deposit to upgrade a miner and promotes referral income, so its promotional character is clear. But the description qualifies the reported results, stating that individual results may vary and that the creator's earnings do not mean viewers will earn the same amount. Those requests and income claims, with the affiliate relationship disclosed and results expressly qualified, do not by themselves establish a deceptive outcome.
